catalog.system: Uses Apple translation and dictionary on macOS, plus built-in OCR on macOS and Windows.
catalog.ecdict: Built-in concise English-Chinese dictionary. Works offline with no API key.
catalog.google_web: Translates through Google Translate’s unofficial web interface. No API key. Experimental.
catalog.bing_web: Translates through Microsoft’s unofficial Edge translator interface. No API key. Experimental.
catalog.tencent_transmart_web: Translates through Tencent Transmart’s unofficial web interface. Optional login. Experimental.
catalog.baidu_ocr: Baidu General OCR with text-line positions.
catalog.youdao: Youdao Zhiyun translation, dictionary, and OCR.
catalog.gemini: Google Gemini via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
catalog.doubao: Volcano Engine Doubao Ark official API.
catalog.libretranslate: Self-hosted LibreTranslate. Default http://127.0.0.1:5000. Not a public instance.
catalog.minimax: MiniMax API using the Anthropic compatible protocol.
catalog.stepfun: StepFun API using the OpenAI compatible protocol.
catalog.mistral: Mistral API using the OpenAI compatible protocol.
catalog.together: Together AI API using the OpenAI compatible protocol.
catalog.fireworks: Fireworks AI API using the OpenAI compatible protocol.
catalog.custom: Connect a custom gateway or another OpenAI compatible service.
